name: Manager
source:
He's the person in charge of the establishment where Ayako and the girls work. Although the manager looks scary, he's a very nice person and can be trusted. 

[Translated from [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20050209080853/http://www.aquarium-soft.com/aquarium/iyashite/char.htm]Official Website[/url].]
